thread:
maria: heads-up — large customer asked for hard bandwidth SLAs for cross-region routing. they want guaranteed 99th p50 token latency under 200ms even if requests spill to eu-west from us-west. any thoughts on runway/constraints? :thinking:

aj: do they mean reserved capacity + cross-region ingress? sounds like Dedicated with cross-region failover + egress costs. we don't currently pin bandwidth across regions.

liam: we could add a routing-policy 'pin-region-with-burst' that keeps primary routing local and uses burst lanes in another region if local saturated. add throttles/cost-shift.

sam: this will need routing + infra changes: bandwidth reservations + evictable tenant lanes. estimate 2 sprints infra + 1 sprint api + config UI change.

devops-bot: deploy started: routing-proxy v2.3 -> canary on staging (pods=12). Logs: tail /var/log/proxy/canary

jules: product: customer will pay for reserved capacity but requires privacy hints and audit. they also want rollback plan and rollout gates. propose launch criteria: 1) SLA verified on perf env 2) canary w/ synthetic traffic 3) cost-swap docs 4) PM signoff.

eden_prod: proposal: expose policy flags: region_affinity: strict|soft|off and spillover_budget_ms per-route. default soft.

liam: +1. Also need telemetry: per-tenant cross-region egress counts, latency percentiles, and cost attribution.

maria: ok can we get a quick spec for engineering prioritization? include migration path for existing tenants and opt-in controls.

aj: i'll draft an RFC by EOD with rough costs. if we want to prioritize for q3 enterprise skus, we need sales ask + 6mo lead time.

sam: tiny note — encryption-in-transit across regions + KMS access patterns need review for Private customers.

maria: perfect. assign owners: aj (RFC + customer scoping), liam (runtime policy design), sam (infra + KMS), jules (launch criteria), eden_prod (api surface). back to me with a one-pager by Wed. :thumbsup:

liam: ping — starting design doc now. adding a quick config example:
```
routing_policy:
  affinity: strict
  spillover_budget_ms: 50
  egress_reserve_gbps: 1.2
```

sam: noted — will list infra blockers in the RFC.
